newsitem.title: USA: CME live cattle seen steady to up, feeders steady.
newsitem.headline: CME live cattle seen steady to up, feeders steady.

text.p: CME live cattle futures were expected to open steady to 0.200 cent per lb higher while feeder cattle were called steady, livestock analysts said.

Another round of gains in boxed beef values and expectations of further gains in fed cattle prices next week were expected to lift live cattle futures. Boxed beef values rose to highest levels since late December on Thursday and packers are expected to pay up to $72 per cwt for fed cattle next week, analysts said.
However, the beef market looks like it may be nearing a top which could limit gains in futures, they said.
Heavy-weight choice boxed beef prices rose $1.30 to $106.08 per cwt Thursday, the highest level since December 31.

Feeder cattle futures were expected to trade near steady as outside influences may continue to give the market direction. Action in deferred months of live cattle is expected to provide the bulk of direction but lower corn futures could lend support and offset any pressure from an easier CME feeder cattle index, they said.
The latest CME feeder cattle index slipped $0.05 at $69.05 per cwt.
